m: 1. वरीयस् mfn. (compar. of उरु, q.v.) wider, broader (‘than’ abl.)
freer, easier, ib.; ŚBr.
वरीयस् (अस्), ind. farther, farther off or away, RV.
वरीयस् n. wider space (‘than’ abl.), ib.
free space, freedom, comfort, ease, rest, ib.
2. वरीयस् mfn. (compar. of 2. वर) better more or most excellent, chief or best or dearest of (gen.), MBh.; BhP.
वरीयस् m. (in astrol.) N. of a Yoga
of Śiva, Śivag.
of a son of Manu Sāvarṇa, Hariv.
of a son of Pulaha by Gati, BhP.
a: वरीयस् — a. 1 Better, more excellent, preferable. --2 Most excellent, very good; Māl. 1. 16. --3 Larger, wider, more extensive (compar. of उरु q. v.). --4 Extremely tender or younger. --n. Ved. Rest, repose.

m: वरीयसी f. Asparagus Racemosus, L.
वरीषु m. N. of Kāma-deva, the god of love, L. (cf. रवीषु).
a: वरीषुः — N. of Cupid, the god of love.
